title: Server-side scorer registration and invoke: decorator (call_source) scorers are blocked unless MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS is set; third-party egress kwargs are always rejected
answers: Why does registering my @scorer decorator scorer on the MLflow server return a 400 'not supported' error?
How do I allow custom decorator scorers to run on the tracking server (env flag)?
Does a decorator scorer nested inside an ensemble get rejected when a scorer is registered or invoked?
Where is the server-side check that blocks third-party judge api_base / completion_kwargs overrides?
body:
Path: Serialized scorer payloads sent to the register-scorer and scorer/invoke endpoints (and stored scorers re-fetched from the tracking store) pass through mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_serialized_scorer_payload before any store write or job submission.
Rule: The decorator check (`call_source` present, i.e. code later exec()'d on deserialization) goes through mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:custom_scorer_execution_blocked, which is opt-in via the MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS env var and recursive into ensemble sub-scorers. The third-party egress check (mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_third_party_scorer_data) is separate and must stay unconditional; never gate it on that flag.
Symptom: Before this change the server rejected any top-level call_source scorer with no operator override, and a decorator nested in an ensemble was not caught by the top-level-only check. Conversely, when relaxing the exec guard, the egress-kwargs guard must not be relaxed with it (that is the SSRF fix GHSA-2wqp-q3c6-ccj5).
Constraints: Applies only to server-side handling of serialized scorers. The client-side _check_can_be_registered() is a separate, client-only check. With the flag unset, decorator scorers stay rejected; with it set, they pass the gate but the third-party kwargs rule still applies to the same payload.
applies: Server-side validation of serialized scorers in mlflow/server/handlers.py; not the Python client registration path.
says: Registering a custom scoring function on the tracking server fails with a not supported error.
Allow administrators to enable custom Python evaluation metrics on the shared tracking server.
Ensemble evaluators containing custom scoring functions get rejected when submitted to the server.
Third party evaluation endpoint overrides are blocked when registering custom model judges.
search: Server-side validation of serialized scorers in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_serialized_scorer_payload blocks decorator scorers with call_source via mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:custom_scorer_execution_blocked unless the MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS environment variable is set. This execution guard recurses into ensemble sub-scorers, whereas third-party egress overrides in _validate_third_party_scorer_data remain unconditionally rejected to prevent SSRF vulnerabilities. The rule applies only to server-side registration and invoke endpoints, leaving client-side validation in _check_can_be_registered separate.
